subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Orpheus and Eurydice
description: Learn Orpheus and Eurydice in one minute.

hook.text: Orpheus played his lyre so beautifully that even Hades wept. He earned the right to bring Eurydice back.

buildup.text: One condition: don't look back as you leave the underworld. Walk forward. Trust that she follows.

discovery.text: Orpheus looked back at the very last moment. Eurydice vanished forever. Love couldn't overcome doubt.

twist.text: The myth punishes doubt, not cruelty. The worst failure is losing faith when you're closest to success.

climax.text: Orpheus proves that emotion can move death—but human weakness ruins the miracle. Art isn't enough.

punchline.text: He looked back. She was already gone.

quiz.question: What rule did Orpheus break in the underworld?
